approval_basis: Reviewed outside the release automation; the Gate binding was resolved once here through the release module's own gate builder rather than by manual re-hashing. The added corpus case atomic-reservation-b8-smoke is an intentional adoption: it is the single added case, expects only RESIDENCY_BOUND, and is the one addition to the 50-source set. The previously reviewed 33 cases show no expectation drift of any kind: none removed, no finding-code list changed, and no accepted or lowering_eligible disposition moved. The Compiler's own check_corpus recomputed the full Gate at 34 of 34 with no mismatched case, and that result plus the gate build was confirmed identical across three repeated runs from a cleared bytecode cache after an earlier transient failure observed while the tree was mid-edit. Semantics accepted: state is a Buffer mode rather than an operation flag and must be both read and written, with STATE_NOT_READ and STATE_NOT_WRITTEN returning read-only or write-only use to input and output; AccessMap remains the sole address owner and the atomic target address is never duplicated into parameters; the OP_SELF_READ_WRITE exemption is scoped to the exact read-write alias of one state target and leaves every other overlap illegal; the Triton body emits one masked relaxed GPU-scope atomic add, requires the exact Target contract through preflight, returns the preceding value and yields zero at masked coordinates; both host ABIs now share _emit_launch_options so caller-owned state does not silently drop the declared maxnreg or pipelining depth; the CuTe route refuses caller-owned mutable state through its own preflight before lowering; and the contention oracle compares each expert's returned positions as a sorted permutation of the pre-launch half-open counter range rather than an invented lane order, with the snapshot taken before launch and the final counters checked against the initial value plus the valid reservations. New vocabulary is exactly state, atomic_rmw, relaxed and device, with no route, moe, dispatch, slot, counter or scatter spelling, and the agent-facing Schema projects the closed enums from the IR rather than mirroring them. Findings raised during this review were converged before approval: the duplicate atomic entry in the generic arity table was removed, ATOMIC_TARGET_SPACE was deleted as a synonym of BUFFER_IO_SPACE on its only reachable path and a falsifier now locks that only BUFFER_IO_SPACE is reported, and ATOMIC_TARGET_EDGE and ATOMIC_INDEX_FORM gained the failure tests they lacked. One non-blocking observation is recorded for a later revision rather than this one: the emitted memory model is bound to the declaration only by construction, since the atomic instruction, sem and scope are literals and nothing reads parameters.op, order or scope. That is safe while each enum has a single member, but it is the shape that let EpilogueFormula diverge once a second member existed, so the first widening should derive the Target contract from the parameters or assert the triple before emitting. ATOMIC_RESULT_SHAPE and ACCESS_INDEXED_RESULT_SHAPE also remain two names for one relation with a byte-identical message, partitioned only by operation kind that the Finding path already localizes. The 88 currently failing suite items were classified line by line, 176 error lines with none outside the pending-release class: the released v26 lock refusing the edited sm_100a Target bytes, whose draft pin was correctly updated by hand as the runbook requires, and the stale Gate report and approval this file replaces. Not in scope of this approval: ADR 0035 remains proposed and its fifth acceptance item, one brokered B200 correctness run satisfying the contention invariant from non-zero initial state, has not been observed. This approves the compiler-side expressibility slice only, claims no complete KDA-version coverage and authorizes no performance claim.
